question_text: What can prevent you from hearing warning signals?

options.text: Having the radio on too loud
Using headphones
The exhaust being too loud

correct_answers.text: Having the radio on too loud
Using headphones
The exhaust being too loud

comment: Other sounds, such as a loud radio or a loud exhaust, can prevent car drivers from perceiving important warning signals. Also, the use of headphones usually limits the ability to hear. This often means that warning signals are ignored by drivers. Make sure that you can always hear warning signals.

question_text: You have sold your vehicle which is still registered. The buyer has paid. What must you do?

options.text: Inform the registration centre immediately of the buyer's name and address
Hand over the vehicle registration certificate (Fahrzeugschein) and vehicle registration book (Fahrzeugbrief) or permit for use (Betriebserlaubnis) to the buyer against receipt
Remove the test stamp from the official registration plate

correct_answers.text: Inform the registration centre immediately of the buyer's name and address
Hand over the vehicle registration certificate (Fahrzeugschein) and vehicle registration book (Fahrzeugbrief) or permit for use (Betriebserlaubnis) to the buyer against receipt

comment: If you have sold your licensed vehicle and received the payment, proceed as follows: 1. You hand over all vehicle documents to the new vehicle owner in exchange for a confirmation of receipt. 2. You report the name and address of the vehicle buyer to the admission office. This way, you protect yourself from unjustified claims that could be caused by traffic violations on the part of the new owner. 3. The inspection plate remains on the vehicle.

question_text: What is important with regard to the official registration plates?

options.text: They must be securely attached at the appropriate places
They must always be easily legible
The rear registration plates must be lit up in darkness

correct_answers.text: They must be securely attached at the appropriate places
They must always be easily legible
The rear registration plates must be lit up in darkness

comment: For license numbers, it is important that they are placed in the required place. In addition, they must be easy to read and illuminated in the dark.

question_text: What is required when your vehicle is no longer covered by motor liability insurance?

options.text: - may no longer be used in road traffic
- must be de-registered at the registration centre
- must be submitted to the registration centre

correct_answers.text: - may no longer be used in road traffic
- must be de-registered at the registration centre

comment: Without a valid liability insurance, a car is not ready to drive and therefore may not participate in public transport. The liability insurance serves to regulate damage that you may be able to inflict on other vehicles. Irrespective of the financial circumstances of the injuring party, compensation for the injured party is thus guaranteed. If there is no liability insurance, the holder must deregister the car at the admission office. Failure to comply with this rule will result in a penalty.

question_text: What are you allowed to change on the official registration plate?

options.text: Nothing
Attach a protective foil for the lettering
Attach coloured stickers

correct_answers.text: Nothing

comment: A license number is an official document, which may not be altered in any way. Therefore, do not attach any foils or stickers to your license plate.

question_text: While you are driving a car you get a call on your mobile phone. What must you be aware of here, if you do not have a hands-free set?

options.text: The journey must be interrupted in order to use the telephone
The engine must be switched off in order to use the telephone
A mobile phone may not be used for more than 15 seconds while driving

correct_answers.text: The journey must be interrupted in order to use the telephone
The engine must be switched off in order to use the telephone

comment: You must keep the cellphone ringing. Taking or holding the phone is generally prohibited for motorists and can lead to high fines. If necessary, stop at the nearest convenient location. First turn off the engine. Only now you are allowed to take your phone into your hands.

question_text: As the vehicle owner, what change must you report to the relevant licensing authority?

options.text: - my home address
- my name
- my third-party insurance

correct_answers.text: - my home address
- my name

comment: If you change your name or place of residence, you must notify the vehicle licensing authority. However, you do not have to report the change in your liability insurance.

question_text: You are the new owner of a licensed vehicle. What do you have to do?

options.text: - notify the licensing authority of the change in ownership
- present the licensing authority with proof of the existence of liability insurance for the vehicle
- generally arrange for a vehicle roadworthiness test to be performed at the time of the change of ownership

correct_answers.text: - notify the licensing authority of the change in ownership
- present the licensing authority with proof of the existence of liability insurance for the vehicle

comment: When replacing the owner, you do not need to carry out a general inspection. You must inform the vehicle licensing authority that the owner changed and provide them with a third-party liability insurance.

question_text: When driving, what can cause you to miss warning signals?

options.text: Listening to loud music
Becoming distracting during a telephone call
Driving at a low engine speed

correct_answers.text: Listening to loud music
Becoming distracting during a telephone call

comment:
Noise that is too loud, such as listening to music that is too loud, can drown out the warning signal and cause you to react to it too late.
Distractions caused by talking on the phone can also mean that you hear warning signals too late or not at all.

question_text: What must be remembered with regard to vehicles with canvass covers?

options.text: The canvass covers must not obstruct the driver's rear view through the outside mirrors
Unloaded trailers with high canvass cover superstructure are particularly sensitive to side wind
When vehicles have canvass covers, a load must not be specially secured

correct_answers.text: The canvass covers must not obstruct the driver's rear view through the outside mirrors
Unloaded trailers with high canvass cover superstructure are particularly sensitive to side wind

comment: For vehicles with tarpaulin you must take care that the view to the back is not impaired. Especially with unloaded trailers with high tarpaulins there is a risk of crosswind.

question_text: What must you adjust when driving a vehicle which is not your own?

options.text: Seat, head rest, safety belt
Inside mirror, outside mirrors
Daily trip counter

correct_answers.text: Seat, head rest, safety belt
Inside mirror, outside mirrors

comment: In order to drive safely with a vehicle that's not your own, you must adjust the driver-specific equipment such as seat, seatbelt, headrest and mirror according to your requirements. You can reset the trip meter, but you do not have to.

question_text: How do you secure a car with a manual gearbox against rolling away on a downhill slope?

options.text: Apply the parking brake
Engage first gear or reverse gear
Put the gear lever in neutral position

correct_answers.text: Apply the parking brake
Engage first gear or reverse gear

comment: You can prevent a car with a manual transmission from rolling away by engaging a small gear, such as first gear or reverse gear. Use the parking brake and do not place the gearstick in the neutral position.

question_text: How do you secure a car with automatic transmission against rolling away on a downhill slope?

options.text: Apply the parking brake
Put the selector lever in the "P" position
Put the selector lever in the "N" position

correct_answers.text: Apply the parking brake
Put the selector lever in the "P" position

comment: You can secure a car with automatic transmission against rolling away by activating the parking brake and additionally bringing the selector lever into the parking position 'P'. You may not select the position 'N', as this is the same as idling in a vehicle with manual transmission.

question_text: What must you do when reversing?

options.text: Mainly look to the back; also check the traffic situation at the front and at the side
Drive with particular attention and slowly
Never drive without switching on the hazard warning lights

correct_answers.text: Mainly look to the back; also check the traffic situation at the front and at the side
Drive with particular attention and slowly

comment: As a car driver, you are only allowed to drive backwards very slowly and with the utmost caution. When driving, look mainly to the back and in all other directions. You do not need to turn on the hazard warning light when reversing.

question_text: What can interfere with your view?

options.text: The load
Worn wiper blades (formation of streaks)
Smeared windows

correct_answers.text: The load
Worn wiper blades (formation of streaks)
Smeared windows

comment: Your vision may be impaired if the windowpane becomes dirty, if streaks form due to worn windscreen wipers, or if cargo obstructs your view.

question_text: A single axle caravan with overrun brake is parked on a downhill slope. How do you have to secure it to prevent it from rolling away?

options.text: Apply the parking brake
Put wheel chocks in front of the wheels
Put one wheel chock in front and one behind the same wheel

correct_answers.text: Apply the parking brake
Put wheel chocks in front of the wheels

comment: In order to protect your caravan from rolling away, you must place the wheel chocks in front of the wheels and additionally secure the trailer with the parking brake.

question_text: Your vehicle is snowed under. What do you have to do before you drive off?

options.text: - remove ice and snow from the windows
- remove ice and snow from the mirrors
- remove ice and snow from the roof of the vehicle

correct_answers.text: - remove ice and snow from the windows
- remove ice and snow from the mirrors
- remove ice and snow from the roof of the vehicle

comment: Before you drive, you must remove the ice from your vehicle, so as not to endanger other road users. Check all windows and mirrors as well as the roof.

question_text: Your vehicle is snowed under. What do you have to do before you drive off?

options.text: - remove ice and snow from the windows and mirrors
- remove ice and snow from the lighting systems including during daytime
- allow the engine to warm up

correct_answers.text: - remove ice and snow from the windows and mirrors
- remove ice and snow from the lighting systems including during daytime

comment: As a car driver, you must make sure before every journey that a risk to other road users is excluded. Therefore, you must also clear all windows and mirrors as well as the roof of ice and snow during the day. The engine must not be used to warm the car up.

question_text: What should be observed when positioning the head rests in your car?

options.text: The top of the head should be level with the upper edge of the head rest
The spacing between the rear of the head and the head rests should be as small as possible
The upper edge of the head rest should conjoin with the upper neck vertebra

correct_answers.text: The top of the head should be level with the upper edge of the head rest
The spacing between the rear of the head and the head rests should be as small as possible

comment: With correctly adjusted headrests the car driver reduces the force on the cervical spine in case of sudden vehicle movements. This makes headrests a direct protection device for the protection of the vehicle occupants in accidents. The headrests that can be adjusted electrically or manually in height and inclination should be adjusted so that the crown height of the head coincides with the top edge of the headrest. In order for their protective function to be fully effective, you should tilt the headrest so that your back of the head is no more than a few centimeters away from it.

question_text: When should you refrain from using the telephone even if you have a hands-free device?

options.text: When the telephone conversations are stressful
In complicated traffic conditions
If this would distract me

correct_answers.text: When the telephone conversations are stressful
In complicated traffic conditions
If this would distract me

comment: Despite the availability of a hands-free system, you are likely to become nervous and anxious during difficult conversations. You will pay more attention to the person you are talking to and concentrate less on the road. Distraction can cause you to miss something in traffic and not be able to react quickly enough. You should also avoid using your phone in difficult traffic situations.

question_text: You want to use a smartphone mounted on your motor vehicle as a navigation device. What should you observe?

options.text: - enter the destination while the vehicle is stationary
- if possible, I should avoid operating the device while driving
- use the device's voice output function

correct_answers.text: - enter the destination while the vehicle is stationary
- if possible, I should avoid operating the device while driving
- use the device's voice output function

comment: To protect yourself, you should enter your destination in the stationary vehicle and, if possible, not operate the device while driving. Use the device's voice output. So you are not distracted and can concentrate on the traffic.

question_text: You receive a telephone call while driving. What must you be aware of?

options.text: - the telephone in not held in my hand for this purpose
- using the telephone only requires a momentary glance
- the telephone is not used for longer than 7 seconds here

correct_answers.text: - the telephone in not held in my hand for this purpose
- using the telephone only requires a momentary glance

comment: Phone use is prohibited if it distracts you too much from the traffic. This inevitably happens when picking up and looking at the display.

question_text: You are planning a long journey with your motor vehicle. Before commencing the journey, what should you check on the vehicle to avoid endangering yourself and others?

options.text: The tyres
The headlamp setting
That the windscreen wipers are working properly

correct_answers.text: The tyres
The headlamp setting
That the windscreen wipers are working properly

comment:
You should check your tyres at regular intervals, because wear, damage or incorrectly adjusted air pressure as well as insufficient tread depth represent a major safety risk.
A minimum tread depth of 1.6 mm applies. 
The headlights should also be checked for defects and their correct setting. For example, headlights that are set too high can dazzle oncoming traffic. 
A clear view should be ensured on every journey. This includes not only ensuring that the windscreen is free of dirt, but also that there is still sufficient windscreen washer fluid.

question_text: What is the main function of the headrest in a car?

options.text: - enhances safety for the occupants
- improves the seating position
- replaces the seatbelt in the rear seats

correct_answers.text: - enhances safety for the occupants

comment: The head restraint reduces the force on the occupants' cervical spine during heavy braking or accidents.

question_text: While driving, the inside of your vehicle’s windscreen begins to mist over. How can you counteract this?

options.text: By turning on the climate control system
By directing the airflow onto the windscreen at full power
By opening the window if the outdoor humidity level is high

correct_answers.text: By turning on the climate control system
By directing the airflow onto the windscreen at full power

comment: By increasing the air circulation on the windscreen, you can prevent the windscreen from misting up. You can also switch on the air conditioning, which dries the air and helps to remove moisture from the windscreen.

question_text: Your car is snowed in. What do you need to do before you start your journey?

options.text: - remove snow from number plate
- remove snow from the vehicle’s roof
- remove snow from the lighting equipment

correct_answers.text: - remove snow from number plate
- remove snow from the vehicle’s roof
- remove snow from the lighting equipment

comment:
Before you drive off, you must remove the snow from the entire vehicle as it could fall while driving and endanger other road users. In addition, the snow could slide onto your windshield when you brake, blocking your visibility and making you completely unable to act.  Also remove the snow from the lighting equipment so that other road users can see you in good time and you have adequate visibility even in dark lighting conditions. 
Also make sure that no snow covers your license plates. If the license plates are illegible, you risk an administrative offense and a fine.

question_text: Which parts of your motor vehicle do you have to completely clear of snow and ice before driving off?

options.text: The windscreen
The exterior mirrors
The side windows

correct_answers.text: The windscreen
The exterior mirrors
The side windows

comment: Before you drive off, you must remove the snow from the entire vehicle as it could fall while driving and endanger other road users. In addition, the snow could slide onto your windshield when you brake, blocking your visibility and making you completely unable to act.

question_text: You want to take a trip in winter weather conditions. What do you need to bear in mind?

options.text: - cause accidents when falling off
- damage other vehicles when falling off
- impair your own vision when falling off

correct_answers.text: - cause accidents when falling off
- damage other vehicles when falling off
- impair your own vision when falling off

comment: Before you drive off, you must remove the snow from the entire vehicle, as it could fall while you are driving, endangering other road users and, in the worst case, causing an accident. In addition, the snow could slide onto your windshield when you brake, blocking your visibility and making you completely unable to act.

question_text: Who is prohibited from using a mobile phone without a hands-free unit when driving?

options.text: - cars
- trucks
- motorcycles

correct_answers.text: - cars
- trucks
- motorcycles

comment: Car drivers are allowed to use mobile and car telephones while driving only with hands-free equipment. As soon as you need to pick up or hold the phone to make the call, it is forbidden to make a call while driving.
